mapper.select: SELECT i.order_id, i.user_id, u.name AS username, s.service_name, s.service_describe, i.reason, i.create_time, i.update_time, i.manage_status, c.name AS consultantName, i.slot_date AS slotDate, i.start_time AS startTime, i.end_time AS endTime FROM item i JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.id JOIN services s ON i.service_id = s.service_id LEFT JOIN consultant c ON i.consultant_id = c.id ORDER BY i.create_time DESC

SELECT i.order_id, i.user_id, u.name AS username, s.service_name, s.service_describe, i.reason, i.create_time, i.update_time, i.manage_status, c.name AS consultantName, i.slot_date AS slotDate, i.start_time AS startTime, i.end_time AS endTime FROM item i JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.id JOIN services s ON i.service_id = s.service_id LEFT JOIN consultant c ON i.consultant_id = c.id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.create_time DESC

SELECT i.order_id, i.user_id, u.name AS username, s.service_name, s.service_describe, i.reason, i.create_time, i.update_time, i.manage_status, c.name AS consultantName, i.slot_date AS slotDate, i.start_time AS startTime, i.end_time AS endTime FROM item i JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.id JOIN services s ON i.service_id = s.service_id LEFT JOIN consultant c ON i.consultant_id = c.id WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT i.order_id, i.user_id, u.name AS username, s.service_name, s.service_describe, i.reason, i.create_time, i.update_time, i.manage_status, c.name AS consultantName, i.slot_date AS slotDate, i.start_time AS startTime, i.end_time AS endTime FROM item i JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.id JOIN services s ON i.service_id = s.service_id LEFT JOIN consultant c ON i.consultant_id = c.id WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId} AND i.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT u.email FROM item i JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.id WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT s.service_id, s.service_name, s.service_describe, s.service_state FROM item i JOIN services s ON i.service_id = s.service_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE services SET booked_count = booked_count + 1 WHERE service_id = #{serviceId} AND (capacity = -1 OR booked_count < capacity)
UPDATE time_slot t INNER JOIN item i ON i.slot_id = t.id SET t.available = 1 WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId} AND i.consultant_id IS NOT NULL

UPDATE time_slot t INNER JOIN item i ON i.slot_id = t.id SET t.available = 1 WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.consultant_id IS NOT NULL AND i.order_id IN
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT service_id FROM item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT i.order_id, i.user_id, u.name AS username, s.service_name, s.service_describe, i.reason, i.create_time, i.update_time, i.manage_status, c.name AS consultantName, i.slot_date AS slotDate, i.start_time AS startTime, i.end_time AS endTime FROM item i JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.id JOIN services s ON i.service_id = s.service_id LEFT JOIN consultant c ON i.consultant_id = c.id
AND i.manage_status = #{manageStatus}
AND s.service_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{serviceName}, '%')
ORDER BY i.create_time DESC
